rule.statement: The genuineness of documents admitted as evidence without requiring further proof under Transitional Provision in Section 3 (a) (ii) of the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Act, No.17 of 2022, is not necessary to discuss.
rule.supporting_quote: However, I am of the opinion that there is no necessity to discuss the genuineness of the said documents as these documents have to be considered as admitted as evidence without requiring further proof under Transitional Provision in Section 3 (a) (ii) of the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Act, No.17 of 2022.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 3 (a) (ii) of the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Act, No.17 of 2022
